utilization.reason: Queueing forms on the sending interface; Ditto exposes measured throughput, so deployable utilization cannot exceed 1.0.

loss.source_of_truth: Ditto link traffic.lossPct / calibrated simulator loss
loss.reason: Delivered utilization saturates at 1.0, so loss is the deploy-time channel that preserves overload information.

notes: Offered overload is not encoded in utilization once throughput saturates.
route_state_v2 includes loss because the calibrated routing decision depends on the finite-queue saturation cliff.
